formation.note: Experiment approval date, used as a lower bound for the collaboration formation.

intervals.label: SppS data taking
intervals.locator: Greybook record for UA5, status history (Completed row); start bounded by the first SppS collisions
intervals.note: Greybook records one "Completed" row from approval (15 February 1979) to 14 February 1989 and no separate Data Taking row, so neither a first-data nor a last-data date is stated. The start is the year of the first SppS collisions (summer 1981, CERN Archives guide for UA1); the end is the start of the Finished status. UA5 data at 900 GeV were published in 1986.

intervals.label: experiment finished
intervals.locator: Greybook record for UA5, status history (Finished row)
intervals.note: Start of the Finished status in Greybook.

summary.plain: The collaboration that built and ran the UA5 streamer-chamber experiment at CERN's proton-antiproton collider; John Rushbrooke was its spokesperson.
summary.technical: UA5 collaboration: spokesperson J. Rushbrooke and contact person C. Booth (Greybook); the 1986 scaling-violations paper has about 40 authors.
